purpose: Define an explicit patch package/set of candidate add/update/remove/move actions over exact canonical identities/paths with base expectations.

topics.name: Canonical Patch
topics.purpose: Define an explicit patch package/set of candidate add/update/remove/move actions over exact canonical identities/paths with base expectations.

semantics.identity_rule: Each patch has an explicit identity.
semantics.base_rule: Patch declares expected base repository/source-set revision/profile.
semantics.action_rule: Each action targets exact canonical identity/path and action type.
semantics.content_rule: Added/updated contract candidate content is explicit.
semantics.remove_rule: Removal requires exact target identity and dependency/reference impact validation.
semantics.move_rule: Path move without semantic identity change is distinguishable from semantic change.
semantics.authority_rule: Possessing patch grants no apply authority.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.

hard_gates.condition: remove selected by filename glob only

references.purpose: Patch changes can be semantically diffed.
